test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify that contains a grammatical error. 

To descend a cragged / mountain, however, was most / difficult and dangerous / than to ascend it.
solution:
The segment that contains a grammatical error is segment 3: "mountain however was most."

Corrected sentence: To descend a cragged mountain, however, was more difficult and dangerous than to ascend it.

• The error is the use of "most" instead of "more" to compare the difficulty and danger of descending versus ascending the mountain.
